finding: WebGL2 geometry is drawn to Cesium offscreen framebuffers; the default framebuffer only receives the final full-screen copy. Disabling native canvas AA changes its observed sample count from 4 to 0 without changing Cesium MSAA/FXAA policy or full captured RGBA.

qualitySummary.scope: Four user quality presets, desktop 3D with high-tier hints and country label preference, mobile 2D low-tier, and desktop 3D automatic low-tier. Full RGBA after postRender, same dimensions and camera, real map data/imagery. Baseline on/off/on repeat controls must match; one warmup per case excluded.

controlLimitation: Early automatic-desktop captures differed between unchanged baselines during progressive imagery/render settling. They are retained as inconclusive controls, not treated as AA differences or approved evidence. Followup requires final desktop imagery and three consecutive loaded postRender frames; all its baseline/candidate bytes match.
methodTextCorrection: The pixel reports inherited a single-case description saying identical low-tier hints. The expanded case matrix actually uses 16 GiB/12-thread hints on desktop high-tier cases, 4 GiB/4-thread hints on desktop-auto-low and mobile, as recorded in the archived source. Hints are identical within each on/off/on control, not across cases. Host hardware remains unchanged; this is not CPU throttling or Linux parity.

pixels.method: Real app and imagery, identical low-tier hints, sequential on/off/on, settled globe, full RGBA postRender capture; visual diagnostic only, no timing claim.

render.method: One excluded warmup, then ABBA ABBA; isolated sequential contexts, low-tier 4/4 hints, same real settled scene, fixed camera and quality, requestRender after each postRender for 3 seconds. Full app targetFrameRate retained. No CPU profiler or pixel readback during timing.
render.limitation: Windows Chrome software renderer, not Linux CI parity, active navigation, whole-app FPS, physical phone or energy/RAM measurement.

renderComparison.method: One excluded warmup, then ABBA ABBA; isolated sequential contexts, low-tier 4/4 hints, final 3d:full imagery and three settled frames, fixed camera and quality, requestRender after each postRender for 3 seconds. Full app targetFrameRate retained. No CPU profiler or pixel readback during timing.
renderComparison.limitation: Windows Chrome software renderer, not Linux CI parity, active navigation, whole-app FPS, physical phone or energy/RAM measurement.

limits: Windows Chrome 155 Intel/SwiftShader are not Linux Chromium 151 CI parity. The 3-second fixed-camera redraw samples are a small diagnostic with variance, not active-navigation or whole-app FPS, energy/CO2 or measured memory savings. No output quality decrease is inferred from timing. Recheck pixel controls when upgrading Cesium; native WebGL1 AA is preserved.
